summary: This clinical trial is testing a new drug called NNC9733-0001 in healthy adults and people with type 2 diabetes, which is a condition where the body has trouble managing blood sugar. Researchers want to learn about the safety and how well the body handles single doses of the study drug compared to an inactive substance called a placebo. The study plans to enroll 60 participants. Participants will receive an injection under the skin in the belly area.
